version.reason: The last version before `mcopy` exists, so no target makes it a built-in.

expected_solc_divergence.reason: solc 0.8.23 declines the Frontier target outright ('Invalid EVM version requested'), which counts as a rejection, while slang accepts the declaration.
On pre-Constantinople targets solc warns that the EVM version is deprecated, which counts as a rejection, while slang is silent.
Cancun support only arrives in solc 0.8.24, so 0.8.23 declines these targets ('Invalid EVM version requested') while slang accepts the declaration — which is the point of this test.
